_comment: Exposure defaults in microseconds per objective, at 1x full resolution (this rig always runs 1x) under tungsten illumination. 5x=40ms, 20x=45ms, 50x=45ms, 100x=120ms MEASURED 2026-07-07 (nearly flat through 50x — per-objective NA compensates for magnification); 10x interpolated between its measured neighbours. Edits apply live on mag change. wb: manual Red/Blue BalanceRatio defaults for the tungsten illuminator, tuned 2026-07-07.
